privacy.en:
Effective October 8, 2026. RefSettle 1.0.

RefSettle keeps your referee pay records on this device. We do not collect your business data. There are no accounts, ads, analytics SDKs, AI services, or business servers.

Apple handles purchases. Export and file selection occur only when you request them. You decide where to save and with whom to share files.

Backups contain personal income records in readable JSON. They are not password-encrypted. Save them to a private location. SHA-256 detects accidental corruption; it is not proof of identity or protection against deliberate changes.

Device snapshots are lost when the app is uninstalled. Save an external backup before uninstalling or moving devices. Data does not automatically sync between iPhone and iPad.

Support: gaozichen@hailinklabs.com. If you contact support, do not send banking credentials or unneeded financial records. Contact correspondence is separate from the local app ledger.

iOS device backups may include local app data according to system settings. Apple StoreKit handles verified purchase and restoration; purchase access is separate from ledger backups. No camera, microphone, location, contacts, photo library or health permissions are needed.
privacy.zh-CN:
生效日期：2026年10月8日。RefSettle 1.0。

比赛、付款人、收款、已知扣减、核销分配、修订、草稿和偏好保存在设备本地，Hailink Labs 不收集这些业务资料。无 App 账号、开发者服务器、广告、分析、追踪或 AI 服务。

Apple 处理购买和恢复，App 只接受已验证交易，我们不接收支付卡信息。购买权益与账簿备份分开。

你选择导出及文件分享位置，文件服务按自身政策处理资料。备份含可读取收入资料，不受密码加密。SHA-256 检测意外损坏，不能证明身份或防止人为修改；请保存在私有位置。系统备份可按设备设置包含本地资料。

卸载会删除设备内快照，卸载或换机前保存外部备份。恢复验证并经确认替换账簿，不合并资料；设备不自动同步。外部备份与已分享副本另行删除。

无需相机、麦克风、位置、通讯录、照片库或健康权限。求助只提供版本、设备和问题简述，不发送密码、银行凭据或不必要财务记录。

support.en:
RefSettle helps you match received referee pay to game fees. No account is required.

1. Record each game and its expected fee. 2. Record a payment only after you actually receive it. 3. Open the payment, choose Match payment, and explicitly enter credit for each game.

Unknown amounts remain unmatched. A short payment does not automatically become a deduction. Only enter known withholding with a confirmed reason; it never increases cash received. A source such as ArbiterPay is separate from the school or league payer identity.

Your first 12 successfully created games are free, with no time limit. Lifetime is a one-time purchase for unlimited new games. Deleting or archiving games does not return the allowance. Existing records, corrections, payments, matching, export, backup, and restore remain available without Lifetime. Use Settings → Restore Purchase with the same Apple Account to restore a verified purchase.

Use Settings → Backup regularly and save a copy outside the device to a private location. Local snapshots are removed when the app is uninstalled. Backups contain readable personal income records and are not password-encrypted. Restore validates a backup, presents a summary, and replaces the device ledger after confirmation; it does not merge. Older backups cannot lower the known cumulative game allowance.

Void is only for incorrect or duplicate payment entries. Real refunds paid out are outside V1. RefSettle does not move money, connect banks, generate invoices, or provide tax advice. Records do not automatically sync between iPhone and iPad.

Contact: gaozichen@hailinklabs.com. Include the app version, device model, and a short description of the problem. Do not send passwords, bank credentials, or unnecessary financial records.
support.zh-CN:
RefSettle 帮助成人裁判核对比赛费用与已收到的报酬，无需账号。

收款核对

记录比赛及预期费用，实际到账后记录收款。打开收款选择 Match payment，为每场明确输入核销额。未知款项保持待核对，不把少款推断为扣减；已知扣减需确认原因，与现金分开。

免费额度与 Lifetime

累计前12场成功创建比赛免费，无时间限制，删除归档不返还额度。一次性非消耗型 Lifetime 解锁不限新增，美国19.99美元，无订阅或家庭共享。已有读取、修改、收款、匹配、导出、备份恢复始终可用。设置中用购买时 Apple 账号执行 Restore Purchase，实际价格由 Apple 显示。

导出和恢复

设置提供 PDF 摘要、完整六表 CSV 和全量备份。备份含可读取收入资料，不受密码加密，保存在设备外私有位置。恢复先验证显示摘要，经确认替换账簿，不合并；旧备份不降低已知累计额度。卸载会删除本地快照。

历史和范围

Void 仅用于错误或重复收款，保留历史并重新计算余额。真实退款支出不在 V1；App 不转账、不连接银行、不开发票或提供税务建议。设备不自动同步，Try sample 不消耗正式额度或进入正式导出。

求助提供版本、设备、步骤和错误，不发送密码、银行凭据或不必要财务记录。
